records.name: Top-to-bottom script execution
records.problem_addressed: Confusion about why changing one widget appears to rerun unrelated code.
records.source_basis: Chapter 1 frames Streamlit apps as Python scripts that render from top to bottom.
records.safe_pattern: Keep rendering deterministic; move non-idempotent work behind explicit events and service calls.
records.dangerous_pattern: Perform database writes, emails, or remote API mutations while rendering page headers or widgets.
inspection_questions: What reruns can reach this code path?
Is any side effect idempotent and behind an explicit submit/confirm/service boundary?
What user-visible state proves the action has or has not completed?
tests_or_checks: Run through widget edits and refreshes without live writes.
Exercise missing-input and invalid-input paths.
Verify status/result state is deterministic after rerun.
